item.title: Montclair Parents Fear Changes at This School No Matter the Outcome of Tax Vote
item.description: Superintendent Ruth B. Turner in an email told families she will hold the meeting to discuss “the status of Renaissance Middle School.” Her message comes after she last week told the school board the district could convert one of its schools into a pre-K facility but did not disclose which school. item.title: Beyond March 10 Vote, Montclair Must Rebuild Trust (Letter to the Editor)
item.description: The letter writer states: "The work ahead isn’t just about restoring trust in our officials. We must restore trust in each other.
